notes: SCORING: 1-5 each; overall = simple average. Venue scores are attached to each venue; the town score uses its best realistic venue. Distance follows the brief (5 <1 h, 4 1-2 h, 3 2-2.5 h, 2 2.5-3 h, 1 >3 h) using Rome2rio drive times (estimates; Rome2rio km figures looked unreliable, so only times are given). 'crowd' rates the chance of 1,000+; CCCL 1 sold about 400 tickets with 400-600 in the building, so no small-town venue is proven at 1,000. WINTER (Jan/Feb/Nov) - venues with evidence they hold dry events in winter: Peterborough Memorial Centre (Nov 21, 2026 concert; OFSAA wrestling Mar 2026), Slush Puppie Place Kingston (BTC MMA in March 2023 and 2024; '5,700 for cold-season events'), Tribute Communities Centre Oshawa (Nov 2026 shows; renovation from 2027), Oshawa Children's Arena (floor only, no ice; capacity unknown), Pickering Casino Resort Arena (2,500; pro boxing Dec 2024), Casino Rama (5,000; no combat since ~2012), Niagara Falls Convention Centre (over 3 h), Nottawasaga Trade Centre Alliston (1,000; over 3 h). No small-town arena (Bancroft, Haliburton, Apsley, Madoc, Lindsay) showed evidence of covering ice for winter events. Shorelines Casino Peterborough has no event space mentioned (Global News 2018). Great Blue Heron's room is about 800. SUMMER 1,000 OPTION FROM EARLIER RESEARCH: Marmora's Dr. Hamilton Crawford Memorial Arena publishes a 1,000 dry-floor capacity at $600/day, May-Aug (https://marmoraandlake.ca/community-centre). It isn't on Cody's town list but is the only small-town venue with a published 1,000 figure. LEAD TIME: OAC amateur event permits need to be filed at least 30 days ahead, and modified-ruleset exemptions 120 days ahead (ontario.ca, from earlier CCCL research). A January 2027 show (under 3 months away) is very tight; February is possible only if the venue is booked now. KEY UNKNOWNS: rental costs at PMC, Slush Puppie Place, TCC, Pickering and Casino Rama (none published); arena-floor capacities in Bancroft, Haliburton, Apsley, Madoc and Lindsay; OHL home schedules for 2027; TCC renovation phasing; whether casinos will rent to an amateur promotion; PFC's November Oshawa plan and BTC's 2027 calendar.
